events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat scored 1:50 into overtime, and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex DeBrincat scores in overtime as the Red Wings beat the Blue Jackets 4-3

events.name: St. Louis Blues at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Brayden Schenn and Pius Suter scored goals and the St. Louis Blues snapped a four-game losing streak with a 2-1 win over the New York Islanders on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues top Islanders 2-1 to snap four-game losing streak

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Noah Dobson and Josh Anderson each scored twice and the Montreal Canadiens snapped a five-game losing streak with a 5-2 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night in a showdown between slumping teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dobson, Anderson each score twice, Canadiens beat Maple Leafs 5-2 to snap 5-game skid

headlines.description: — Jack Roslovic scored twice, Evan Bouchard had three assists and the Edmonton Oilers topped the Florida Panthers 6-3 on Saturday night in a matchup of the teams that played for the Stanley Cup in each of the last two seasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers end winless streak with a 6-3 victory over the Panthers in Cup rematch

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — The Philadelphia Flyers set a franchise record by scoring three goals in just 26 seconds in the first period on Saturday night against New Jersey, getting two from Tyson Foerster in 17...
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers set franchise record with 3 goals in 26 seconds and beat Devils 6-3 on Bernie Parent Tribute

headlines.description: — Brandon Montour scored with 50 seconds left in overtime to give the Seattle Kraken a 3-2 win over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montour's OT winner carries Seattle past Pittsburgh, 3-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel scored two goals and added two assists and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Washington Capitals 5-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hagel scores twice as Lightning hold on to top Capitals 5-3

events.name: Ottawa Senators at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Tim Stutzle scored his team-leading 11th goal of the season in the third period as the Ottawa Senators beat the San Jose Sharks 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tim Stutzle's goal in 3rd period lifts the Senators to a 3-2 victory over the Sharks

headlines.description: — MacKenzie Blackwood made 35 saves to lead the Colorado Avalanche to a 3-0 victory over the Nashville Predators on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blackwood makes 35 saves as Avalanche shut out Predators 3-0

events.name: New York Rangers at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Nick DeSimone scored the tiebreaking goal 7:32 into the third period and the Utah Mammoth beat the scuffling New York Rangers 3-2 on Saturday night to snap a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeSimone scores go-ahead goal in 3rd and Mammoth beat slumping Rangers 3-2 to stop 4-game skid

headlines.description: — Nazem Kadri scored the deciding goal in the fourth round of a shootout, Devin Cooley made 28 saves and the Calgary Flames beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 on Saturday night to escape the NHL cellar.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nazem Kadri scores in 4th round of shootout to lift Flames past Stars, 3-2

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored with 1:03 left in overtime to give the Anaheim Ducks a 4-3 win over the Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutter Gauthier capitalizes on Mitch Marner's mistake to give Ducks 4-3 OT win over Golden Knights
